events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools by for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. I’ll let everyone know you’re coming by with tools.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Gus: You bet — I’ll swing by with my toolbox and a few extras.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away—folks will hear about it from me. Want me to mention anything specific when I do?
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Quinn—please tell folks we’re looking for volunteers, spare tools, and anyone with repair skills. And if they can, have them bring items needing small fixes to the drive.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll make sure folks know we need volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, and I’ll tell them to bring small fixes along too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Bo — just tell folks we’d love volunteers, spare tools, and anyone handy with repairs to stop by. If they’ve got small fixes, bring those along too.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll spread the word for volunteers, spare tools, and anyone handy with repairs. I’ll also tell folks to bring small fixes if they have them.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate you spreading the word.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll sort the repair list by priority and group the jobs so we can assign people efficiently. If you have any urgent repairs, send them my way first.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Gus: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll send you anything urgent right away, and I can still bring those tools by for the drive.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Bring the tools by whenever works for you, and I’ll keep organizing the urgent repairs as they come in.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Gus: That’d be great, Oren — please mention we still need volunteers, spare tools, and folks with repair skills. And have them bring any small items that need fixing.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Oren: Oh, absolutely — I’ll mention volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, and tell folks to bring any small things that need fixing. Just point me to the first place to start.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Gus: Great — start with the folks closest by, then we’ll work outward. I’ll bring a few tools along too.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — if you can, please spread the word that we still need volunteers, spare tools, and folks with repair skills, and have people bring any small fixes along too.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Sure, I can spread the word — volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, plus any small fixes. I’m still getting caught up, so that’s really helpful.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate it. That’ll help the repair drive a lot.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word about volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, and tell folks to bring any small fixes too.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate it. That’ll help the repair drive a lot.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Glad to help — I’ll pass it along and see who can pitch in.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word as soon as the times are set. We’ll keep the repair drive moving smoothly.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — yes, we could use a hand on Sunday at the community center, especially with setup or checking folks in. If you’re free, I can send the timing details next.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Oren — send the timing details when you can, and I’ll help spread the word about Sunday at the community center.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word, Gus — volunteers, spare tools, and anyone handy with repairs. I’ll also tell folks to bring any small fixes along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate it. That’ll help the repair drive a lot.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word and bring a couple broken items to fix. Just send me the time once it’s locked in, and I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Nell
